description: Whether a reference resolves to a real work. Use when an answer is about to cite a paper. Give a DOI, an arXiv id or the reference as written. Answers found, confirm (with the reason), not found in the named sources on a date, or couldn't check. A not-found is not proof a work was never published.

identifier.description: The reference to check: a DOI (10.x/y, doi:10.x/y or a doi.org URL), an arXiv id, or the reference as written (a title or a full citation)

name: check_reference
title: Check reference
